2116360594416927093.en_summary: Questions how a certain strategy differs from a failsafe for climate change by just stopping greenhouse gas emissions. Notes that theoretically some individually rational actions can have negative externalities that warrant changes to policy.
2116360594416927093.zh_summary: 質疑某種策略與僅透過停止溫室氣體排放來應對氣候變化的萬無一失方法有何不同。指出理論上某些個人理性行為可能產生負外部性，需要政策調整。

2116357848464601125.en_summary: BREAKING: OpenAI has slashed its funding target by $10 billion and its valuation by $150 billion amid this week's technology stock selloff, per FT. Now seeking to raise $20 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, down from $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation. First close expected to bring in less than $20 billion after some investors lowered allocations. Comes just weeks before the expected Anthropic IPO.
2116357848464601125.zh_summary: 突發：據《金融時報》報道，OpenAI在本週科技股拋售中將融資目標削減100億美元，估值削減1500億美元。現尋求以1.25萬億美元估值融資200億美元，低於原先以1.4萬億美元估值的300億美元。首次關閉預計少於200億美元，因部分投資者降低配額。這發生在預期Anthropic IPO前數週。

2116357741652684967.en_summary: #EgyptWatch: Egypt’s central bank just hiked its rates by 1%, too little too late. Egypt’s inflation is 14.0%/yr, above its long-term target of 3-7%/yr. Its money supply (M2) is growing at 17.0%/yr, above Hanke’s Golden Growth Rate of 11.1-15.1%/yr.
2116357741652684967.zh_summary: #埃及觀察：埃及央行剛剛加息1%，為時已晚且力度不足。埃及通膨率為14.0%/年，高於長期目標3-7%/年。其貨幣供應（M2）增長17.0%/年，高於Hanke黃金增長率11.1-15.1%/年。

2116353331383648663.en_summary: Agrees with upgrades to Coinbase's 'on a call' protections to keep users safe from scam calls. Scammers coach victims through settings changes, IDV, asset conversion and transfers. Expanded warnings across high-risk app surfaces when Coinbase is not on the call.
2116353331383648663.zh_summary: 同意Coinbase升級「通話中」保護，以保護用戶免受詐騙電話。詐騙者常在電話中引導受害者更改設定、身份驗證、資產轉換及轉賬。已在多個高風險應用介面擴展警告，當Coinbase並未參與通話時提示。

2116350504385012176.en_summary: Counters that AI is not a gamble but the most powerful and useful software ever created, responding to SenSanders on Microsoft, Meta, Google, Amazon, SpaceX, Oracle & Nvidia racking up $3 trillion in debt on a high-stakes AI gamble, and that they won't be bailed out.
2116350504385012176.zh_summary: 反駁稱AI並非賭博，而是有史以來最強大且有用的軟體，回應桑德斯有關微軟、Meta、谷歌、亞馬遜、SpaceX、甲骨文及英偉達在AI高風險賭博上累積3萬億美元債務，且不會被救助的說法。
